dataset.name: emoUERJ
dataset.credit: R. G. Bastos Germano, M. Pompeu Tcheou, F. da Rocha Henriques and S. Pinto Gomes Junior (2021). emoUERJ: an emotional speech database in Portuguese. Zenodo, CC BY 4.0.

hardware: Apple M5 Pro, CPU only, 4 threads

method.zero_shot: argmax over emotion groups of Ears' display z-scores; no labels used
method.probe_loso: logistic regression on Ears' 192 raw scores, leave one speaker out (8 folds)
method.uar: unweighted average recall over the 4 emotions; chance is 0.25
